bindings.statement: Under the declared scalar field interpretation, OMAI PF = sigma_e*S^2 is Physlib ThermoelectricMaterial.powerFactor.
conditions: Use a ThermoelectricMaterial satisfying its field constraints; identify OMAI scalar sigma_e with M.sigma and Seebeck with M.S.
Strict positivity additionally requires S != 0.

conventions.model_scope: Isotropic scalar thermoelectric material in linear response at one shared operating point.
conventions.component_scope: Scalar electronic conductivity and Seebeck; lattice and total conductivity use only an explicitly isotropic diagonal specialization, never arbitrary tensor entries or trace averaging.
conventions.normalization_basis: Intensive bulk transport coefficients, not device conductance.
conventions.unit_embedding: sigma in S/m; S in V/K; kappa in W/(m K); absolute T in K; PF in W/(m K^2); zT dimensionless.
conventions.held_fixed: All coefficients evaluated at the same T, carrier density/doping, composition, and model.
conventions.admissibility: sigma > 0, kappa_l > 0, kappa_e >= 0; coefficients must describe the material.

remaining_obligations: The reviewed scalar formula interpretation and positivity transfer are compiled. Numerical electronic transport producers, finite precision, and physical adequacy are not certified.

bindings.statement: The complete Nat-spectrum harmonic ensemble's CanonicalEnsemble.helmholtzFreeEnergy equals OMAI's single-mode HelmholtzFreeEnergy formula at positive temperature and angular frequency.
conditions: Use an upstream quantum harmonic oscillator with positive mass and angular frequency, exact upstream hbar and kB, and positive absolute temperature.
Use the constructed Nat counting-measure ensemble with dof=0 and phase-space unit=1; the partition sum, Boltzmann finiteness and energy integrability are proved.
Interpret Bose occupation as n_BE(x)=1/(exp(x)-1) with x=hbar*omega/(kB*T), and convert any stored linear THz to angular frequency.

conventions.model_scope: Independent stable quantum harmonic mode at fixed volume, with countably infinite levels E_n=hbar*omega*(n+1/2).
conventions.component_scope: One fixed (q,nu) mode; no mixing of mode-indexed values and extensive ensemble values.
conventions.normalization_basis: One oscillator; counting measure, dof=0, phase-space unit=1.
conventions.frequency_convention: Symbolic omega is angular rad/s. Canonical linear THz requires omega=2*pi*10^12*nu_THz, not value identity.
conventions.unit_embedding: Use the exact upstream hbar and kB in one consistent unit system: J, K and angular rad/s in SI; entropy and heat capacity are J/K.
conventions.held_fixed: Mode spectrum, q weights, and cell volume fixed when differentiating in T.
conventions.admissibility: T>0, omega>0, hbar>0, kB>0; zero/imaginary/unstable modes excluded and not assigned totalized Lean values.
conventions.reference_energy: The spectrum includes hbar*omega/2; this constant contributes to F and U but not to S or C.
conventions.qpoint_weighting: No q sum at the single-mode stage.

remaining_obligations: The caller must justify this oscillator model and its frequency/unit interpretation for the material. No dynamical-matrix or phonon-producer theorem, zero-mode prescription or numerical implementation proof is supplied.

bindings.statement: The uniform-q contraction N_A/N_q of the proved single-mode Physlib helmholtzFreeEnergy quantities equals OMAI's molar HelmholtzFreeEnergy formula for a finite positive-frequency grid.
conditions: Use a finite grid Fin N_q x Fin (3*N_atoms), with positive natural N_q and N_atoms. Fin labels map to OMAI 1-based labels by i.val+1.
Each grid entry is an upstream positive-frequency harmonic oscillator with exact upstream hbar and kB; all entries share one positive absolute temperature.
Use uniform q weights 1/N_q and a positive Avogadro scale N_A in the chosen molar units. Do not divide by the branch count or atom count.
All modes must have strictly positive frequencies. An unmodified Gamma grid with zero acoustic modes does not satisfy the premises.
Hold the mode spectrum, weights and primitive-cell basis fixed; convert stored linear THz to angular frequency.

conventions.frequency_convention: Symbolic omega is angular rad/s. Canonical linear THz requires omega=2*pi*10^12*nu_THz, not value identity.
conventions.unit_embedding: Per-mode energy in J and entropy/heat capacity in J/K; molar outputs in J/mol or J/(mol K) of primitive cells. The explicit positive Avogadro parameter is interpreted as N_A in the chosen units.
conventions.held_fixed: Mode spectrum, q weights, and cell volume fixed when differentiating in T.

conventions.reference_energy: The spectrum includes hbar*omega/2; this constant contributes to F and U but not to S or C.
conventions.qpoint_weighting: Uniform q weight 1/N_q, N_q>0; sum all 3*N_atoms branches.

remaining_obligations: A joint product ensemble and its partition-function/additivity theorem are not constructed. Nonuniform q weights, zero-mode prescriptions, per-atom basis conversion, phonon producers and numerical implementation validation remain outside this contraction proof.

Set sigma_OMAI=-stress_Physlib in the same pressure units. Fin 3 axes 0,1,2 correspond to OMAI axes 1,2,3. No static, equilibrium or positive-pressure assumption is required.
